title: Lipschitz bound in the second threshold
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and let $\alpha,\beta,\beta'$ be real, with $\beta,\beta'\in[0,1]$. The absolute difference between the Gaussian bivariate stability at thresholds $(\alpha,\beta)$ and $(\alpha,\beta')$ is at most $|\beta-\beta'|$.
